title: NSClient Dev-l not syncing on profile switch cancelation
body:
**Version:** Dev-l (on both AAPS and NSClient)  

**Issue Description:**  
- Changed profile to 150% and synced ok to NSClient  
- Automation canceled the high profile from 150% to 100% but profile was not changed to 100% on NSClient. 
- Also noticing a small IOB deviation (0.01U on AAPS to Neg. IOB on NSClient).  
- On NSClient I cannot switch to 100% manually. It's frozen on 150%.  
- Had no issues with Dev-K

Logs attached. 

**NSClient**
